description: React component for managing data backups, including download and import functionalities, with encryption options and file handling.

methods.name: downloadDataArchive
methods.description: Handles creating and downloading a backup file, encrypted or decrypted based on user selection.

methods.name: readFile
methods.description: Reads a backup file, parsing JSON or alerting on ZIP files or invalid formats.

methods.name: performImport
methods.description: Imports backup data into the application and shows success or error dialogs.

methods.name: importFileSelected
methods.description: Handles file selection, reads the file, checks version support, and triggers import.

methods.name: handleImportFile
methods.description: Handles click or key events to trigger file input for import.
